ENG-412.title: Export job times out for large workspaces
ENG-412.description: Customers with more than 50k rows get a 504 from the CSV export. Acme Corp raised this two times; they need it before their quarter close. The export worker also runs on a library version that is out of support.

acme/exporter#77.title: fix: stream CSV export instead of buffering
acme/exporter#77.body: The export buffers the whole result set in memory today. Switch to a streamed writer and add a 30s timeout for each chunk. Upgrades the CSV library to the supported major version. Adds an integration test for 100k rows. closes ENG-412
